SettingsGeneralInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [display_name, support_url, logo_url, human_key_max_lifetime_days]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsPrivacyInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [openrouter_data_collection, request_log_retention_days]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsEmailInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [host, port, tls, username, password_ref, from_address, from_name]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsStorageGroupInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [enabled, retention_days]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsStorageRetentionInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [retention_days]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsStorageInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [batch, video, user_files, export]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsAlertRuleInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [name, kind, enabled, budget_layers, thresholds, spike_factor_percent, min_spend_microusd, window_minutes, error_rate_percent, min_requests, consecutive_failures, provider_connection_id, spend_period, spend_amount_microusd, ceiling_requests_per_second, ceiling_lock_wait_ms, notify_workspace_admins, notify_platform_admins, notify_emails]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsWebhookCreateInput.description: Closed serde struct object or positional array [label, url, current_secret_ref]. Deserialization constraints only; handler validation additionally applies.

SettingsChronoDateTime.description: The real chrono DateTime<Utc> serde parser, including relaxed RFC 3339 spellings; response timestamps use canonical date-time instead.

SettingsWebhookPatchInput.description: Manually decoded JSON via serde_json::from_slice, independent of Content-Type. Positional array order is [label, enabled, current_secret_ref, previous_secret_ref, previous_secret_until], with trailing elements omittable. No URL update field. Omitted fields retain saved values. Explicit null is rejected for label/enabled/current_secret_ref, but clears previous_secret_ref/previous_secret_until; both rotation fields must be jointly present/absent in the resulting state. References must be allowlisted env:NAME references, never secret values.

SettingsGeneral.description: General settings. `logo_url` is the deprecated external URL; `updated_by` is the email of the last writer and is null when no writer is recorded or the writer has no email.

SettingsEmailTest.description: Outcome of one test message to the signed-in admin; `error` is a delivery category, never a relay reply.

SettingsTestResult.description: Outcome of one signed test delivery; `error` is a fixed category, never a destination URL or reply.

error.description: Failure code of the last probe; null when it passed.

anyOf.description: Outcome of the last probe; `current` says whether it ran against the configured store.

SettingsStorageTest.description: Outcome of one put/get/delete probe; the round trip is only known for a successful probe.

scim.description: SCIM requires OIDC sign-in, so it is always off here.

last_failure_at.x-omg-unobserved-branch: Set only after a failed JWKS refresh, which needs a controllable clock beyond the unknown-key and failure backoff intervals; the cache unit tests in identity/jwks.rs cover it and the HTTP surface cannot fail the refresh.

SettingsPlatformRules.description: Installation rules, at most 200, ordered by lower(name).

SettingsWorkspaceRules.description: A Team/Project workspace lists its configurable rules (writable only for an administrator with actual membership); a personal workspace lists none and describes its fixed built-in budget alert (builtin), which is never writable.

anyOf.x-omg-unobserved-branch: Shared closed envelope: the concrete event variants refine this property to the alternatives reachable for them and each variant observes those; this base alternative is deliberately not an observation obligation of its own.

Shared closed envelope: the concrete event variants refine this property to the alternatives reachable for them and each variant observes those; this base alternative is deliberately not an observation obligation of its own.

details.$comment: EVENT_JSON returns non-ceiling alert_events.details verbatim as stored producer-specific JSON; monetary refinements apply and ceiling variants refine it with the closed SettingsCeilingDetails schemas.
details.description: Stored JSON incident payload, not a serde DTO. Fields vary by producer/kind; readers do not deserialize or close this map. Monetary fields remain integer micro-USD strings. Admission-ceiling incidents additionally refine it with the closed SettingsCeilingDetails* variants.

anyOf.x-omg-unobserved-branch: Shared closed envelope: the concrete event variants refine this property to the alternatives reachable for them and each variant observes those; this base alternative is deliberately not an observation obligation of its own.

Shared closed envelope: the concrete event variants refine this property to the alternatives reachable for them and each variant observes those; this base alternative is deliberately not an observation obligation of its own.

Shared closed envelope: the concrete event variants refine this property to the alternatives reachable for them and each variant observes those; this base alternative is deliberately not an observation obligation of its own.

Shared closed envelope: the concrete event variants refine this property to the alternatives reachable for them and each variant observes those; this base alternative is deliberately not an observation obligation of its own.

SettingsAlertEvent.description: Closed envelope shared by every alert incident variant: identity and lifecycle fields. The variants (installation rule, built-in, aged hold, admission ceiling, workspace rule, personal built-in) pin rule, workspace, connection, kind and details exactly; this base `details` is the reviewed stored producer-specific JSON.

SettingsRedactedCeilingEvent.description: A Team/Project admission-ceiling incident as a non-Admin platform reader (Auditor) sees it: no workspace reference and no name, including in the details.

url.description: Canonical approved destination: https, or http only for a loopback host in a development environment (config.rs AlertWebhookPolicy::canonical); never userinfo, query or fragment.

SettingsWebhook.description: Read projection: privileged (URL and both secret references) only for a live Platform Admin, and for a token also settings:write; an Auditor or a platform:read-only token gets the redacted projection with no URL or reference fields at all. No response contains signing secret values.

message.const: Installation-wide limits were removed; set limits on workspace-type defaults, workspaces or API keys, and use an installation spend alert to watch total spend

SettingsLogoMetadata.description: Metadata of the uploaded installation logo (never the image bytes or a storage path).

SettingsGeneralLogoSet.description: Result of a logo upload: the logo is set and the deprecated `logo_url` is always cleared.

SettingsGeneralLogoCleared.description: Result of a logo removal: `logo` is always null (the deprecated `logo_url` is left as it was).

SettingsEmailUnconfigured.description: Delivery is off: every relay field is null.

anyOf.description: Allowlisted environment reference, never the SMTP password value.

password_ref_allowed.description: Null when no password reference is saved.

error.description: Delivery category of the last failed test; null when it succeeded.

SettingsEmailConfigured.description: A saved relay. `last_test` is the outcome of the last test against exactly this configuration, null until one ran.

anyOf.description: Allowlisted environment reference, never the SMTP password value.

password_ref_allowed.description: Null when no password reference is saved.

SettingsEmailConfiguredSaved.description: A relay just saved: saving always clears the previous test result.

SettingsConnectionRef.description: Provider connection reference: identity only, never credentials or endpoints.

SettingsPlatformRule.description: A installation alert rule exactly as alerts::RULE_JSON returns it. Installation rules: workspace_id is always null; notify_workspace_admins is always false (rejected on write). firing counts the rule's open incidents; last_fired_at is the latest incident's time.

SettingsPlatformCreatedRule.description: A installation alert rule exactly as alerts::RULE_JSON returns it. Installation rules: workspace_id is always null; notify_workspace_admins is always false (rejected on write). A freshly created rule has no incidents: firing is 0 and last_fired_at is null.

SettingsWorkspaceRule.description: A workspace alert rule exactly as alerts::RULE_JSON returns it. Team/Project rules only: budget, spend-spike, error-rate and batch kinds; connection, installation-spend and ceiling fields are always null. firing counts the rule's open incidents; last_fired_at is the latest incident's time.

SettingsWorkspaceCreatedRule.description: A workspace alert rule exactly as alerts::RULE_JSON returns it. Team/Project rules only: budget, spend-spike, error-rate and batch kinds; connection, installation-spend and ceiling fields are always null. A freshly created rule has no incidents: firing is 0 and last_fired_at is null.

SettingsInstallationRuleRef.description: The installation rule that raised an incident; deleted rules keep their history.

SettingsWorkspaceRuleRef.description: The workspace rule that raised an incident; deleted rules keep their history.

SettingsSharedWorkspaceRef.description: A Team or Project workspace reference.

SettingsPersonalWorkspaceRef.description: The caller's own personal workspace (only its owner is ever shown it).

SettingsInstallationRuleEvent.description: An incident raised by an installation rule. Budget incidents name the Team/Project they concern; provider incidents name the connection.

SettingsInstallationBuiltinEvent.description: A built-in installation incident (last administrator via SCIM, missing partitions, history orphans): no rule, workspace or connection.

SettingsAgedHoldEvent.description: Holds with unknown cost over the age threshold. A Team/Project incident names the workspace; a personal scope is only counted, never named, so its workspace is null.

SettingsCeilingDetailsTeam.description: Admission-ceiling incident details for a Team/Project exactly as alerts::ceiling_conditions writes them, as shown to a Platform Admin: personal is false and the workspace name is present. No workspace id or owner identity is ever included.

SettingsCeilingDetailsPersonal.description: Admission-ceiling incident details for a personal workspace: personal is true, workspace_kind is personal and the name is null (or removed for a non-Admin). Never an id, name or owner, for any audience.

SettingsCeilingDetailsRedacted.description: Admission-ceiling incident details of a Team/Project as shown to a non-Admin platform reader: the workspace name is removed entirely.

SettingsTeamCeilingEvent.description: A Team/Project admission-ceiling incident as a Platform Admin sees it: the workspace reference and name are present.

SettingsPersonalCeilingEvent.description: A personal-workspace admission-ceiling incident. Even Platform Admins never receive the workspace identity: workspace is null and so is the name.

SettingsPlatformEvents.description: Installation history, newest first: installation-rule incidents, built-in installation incidents and aged-hold incidents; admission-ceiling identities follow the reader's role.

SettingsWorkspaceRuleEvent.description: An incident raised by a workspace rule of that Team/Project (the rule may since have been deleted).

SettingsPersonalBudgetEvent.description: The built-in personal budget alert, shown to the personal workspace's owner only.

SettingsWorkspaceSystemEvent.description: A key-expiry reminder or aged-unknown-hold incident of the workspace; neither has a rule.

SettingsWorkspaceEvents.description: One workspace's history, newest first: ordinary incidents only. Admission-ceiling incidents belong to installation rules and are never returned here.

url.description: Canonical approved destination: https, or http only for a loopback host in a development environment (config.rs AlertWebhookPolicy::canonical); never userinfo, query or fragment.

SettingsWebhookCreated.description: A newly created destination: always disabled, with no rotation, deliveries or errors yet. Create responds with the privileged projection (the caller is a writer).
